name: PepsiCo - Brookshire TX (1NA Mixing Center DC)

fieldNotes.truckGate: as of the latest imagery (sat + Street View 2025-04, pre-PepsiCo move-in Oct 2025) the site is a completely open spec build: no perimeter fence along Kingsland Blvd, no gate, no booth at either access. PepsiCo may have added gating during fit-out — flagged
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: multiple uncontrolled access points: E end onto the NE-SW park road and W end onto the western park road; S dock court reached around either building end
fieldNotes.dockDoors: true cross-dock ~1.05M sq ft (Hunt Southwest I-10 West Trade Center): the S face alone shows 60+ dock doors in a continuous run in Street View; N face has additional doors at the NE section. dockDoorCount=120 is a design estimate, 50+ band is certain
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~40 tractorless trailers visible (E-end column + N-end rows); long striped trailer rows in the S court were empty at capture. Capacity is far higher (est 200+)
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: cross-dock with dock banks on both long faces
fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: geocode pin sits on Kingsland Blvd between this building and the Ross DC complex to the south; footprint measurement (~650m x 150m = ~1.05M sq ft) plus news coverage (largest Houston industrial lease 2025, move-in Oct 2025) pins PepsiCo to the NE building
fieldNotes.urbanRural: I-10 logistics corridor at Brookshire, open fields and prairie around the park -> Rural
